reading.title: The scandal surrounding the head of Nvidia could have wide-ranging implications
reading.summary: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer speaks with Bloomberg tech reporter Ian King about the unusually overarching role of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at his company and within the American tech industry at large.

news.title: 'It can kill us': Kenyans fear impact of El Niño with floods predicted
news.summary: Forecasters warn that this year's El Niño could be one of the strongest on record, with heavy rain and flooding in Kenya.
